stored_text.note: official.html is the CAC release notice of 15 Sept 2025 in Chinese; it describes the framework and links to the framework PDF (//www.cac.gov.cn/rootimages/uploadimg/1759653474200838/1759653474200838.pdf), which was not stored. secondary.html is the wrong document: it is the TC260 home page (leadership list and news ticker of Sept 2026), not the postDetail page for the framework. The framework text itself is not stored; the summary was checked against the CAC notice, which is where its claims come from.

english_version.publisher: Cyberspace Administration of China (hosting the TC260 framework PDF)
english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. Two web searches found no standalone English PDF; one search result reported that the framework PDF linked from the CAC notice is bilingual, with the English text after the Chinese. That PDF was not stored or opened here, so whether it carries an English version, and of what kind, is unconfirmed. It is a lead.

title.source_quote: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0版发布
title.why: The stored notice writes the title as 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0版 (book-title marks, no parentheses). original_title '人工智能安全治理框架（2.0版）' adds full-width parentheses that do not occur in the stored text; the wording is otherwise the same. The English 'AI Safety Governance Framework (Version 2.0)' renders it accurately and matches the English title used for version 1.0; the PDF cover, which may give the exact form, is not stored.

summary_claims.claim: tracks changing risks, refines the risk classification, begins to explore risk grading (tiering), and updates the technical and governance countermeasures
summary_claims.original_quote: 作为全国网安标委技术文件，《框架》2.0版在2024年《框架》基础上，结合人工智能技术发展和应用实践，持续跟踪风险变化，完善优化风险分类，研究探索风险分级，动态调整更新防范治理措施。
summary_claims.literal_translation: As a TC260 technical document, Framework 2.0, on the basis of the 2024 Framework and in light of AI technology development and application practice, continuously tracks changes in risk, improves and optimises the risk classification, researches and explores risk grading, and dynamically adjusts and updates the prevention and governance measures.

summary_claims.claim: Drafting was led by CNCERT under CAC guidance, and it was issued as a TC260 technical document (notes)
summary_claims.original_quote: 在国家网信办指导下，由国家互联网应急中心牵头组织人工智能专业机构、科研院所、行业企业联合制定了《框架》2.0版。
summary_claims.literal_translation: Under the guidance of the Cyberspace Administration of China, the National Internet Emergency Center [CNCERT] took the lead in organising AI specialist institutions, research institutes and industry enterprises to jointly formulate Framework 2.0.

summary_claims.claim: Released at the main forum of the 2025 National Cybersecurity Publicity Week (notes)
summary_claims.original_quote: 9月15日，在2025年国家网络安全宣传周主论坛上，《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0版（以下简称《框架》2.0版）正式发布。
summary_claims.literal_translation: On 15 September, at the main forum of the 2025 National Cybersecurity Publicity Week, the AI Safety Governance Framework version 2.0 (hereinafter Framework 2.0) was formally released.

key_terms.note: Distinct from 风险分类 (risk classification), which the register keeps separate.

Literally 'prevention and governance measures'. 'Technical' is not in the notice; it echoes the framework's own split into technical countermeasures and comprehensive governance measures, so it is defensible.

key_terms.original: 全国网安标委技术文件
key_terms.note: 全国网安标委 is the short form of the National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260).

issues: secondary.html is the TC260 home page, not the framework's posting; the framework PDF linked from the CAC notice is not stored, so only the CAC notice can be checked.
original_title adds full-width parentheses ('（2.0版）') not found in the stored text, which has 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0版.
'technical and governance countermeasures' adds 'technical' to the notice's 防范治理措施 (prevention and governance measures).
note: Every summary and notes claim checked is supported by the CAC notice. A web lead says the framework PDF on cac.gov.cn contains an English text; storing it would settle the English title and whether an official English version exists.
